provenance: Category list and the guardian-confidentiality age thresholds below are an ENGINEERING SEED authored to give the confidentiality mechanism something to load. They are NOT law, NOT national policy, and NOT a legal determination. Every age value carries verificationStatus UNVERIFIED and a legalBasisToVerify pointing at the instrument that would settle it. Zimbabwean consent ages are not uniform across services — independent consent for HIV testing, contraception and mental health care are governed by different instruments and have been amended at different times — which is exactly why this cannot be an engineering call. See docs/clinical-governance/adolescent-confidentiality-seed-policy.md.
inertnessNote: effective=false and approvalStatus!=RATIFIED mean this pack grants nothing and withholds nothing. The mechanism that reads it is fully built and tested; it changes no behaviour until someone with the authority to decide sets these values and ratifies the pack. This is deliberate: a record must never carry a protection label that does not protect it.

consumers.protectedCategories: tshepo-authz PDP — the vocabulary of confidential-category grants carried on the VisibilityProfile obligation.
consumers.guardianConfidentialityRules: The clinical system of record at STAMP time, not the PDP. Deciding whether a record is confidential from a guardian needs the patient's age, which the PDP does not have — it sees a subject identifier, never a date of birth. pct-service knows the age and stamps accordingly; the PDP then only has to honour the stamp.

guardianConfidentialityRules.legalBasisToVerify: Age of independent consent to HIV testing and to disclosure of HIV status. Check the Public Health Act [Chapter 15:17] as amended (2018) and any subsequent statutory instrument, together with current MoHCC HIV testing services guidelines.
openQuestions: Does independent consent to testing imply confidentiality of the result from a guardian, or are they separate determinations?
Does a younger child in HIV care hold any confidentiality against a guardian who is also their treatment supporter?
sourceRefs: TO BE SUPPLIED BY MoHCC / legal review

guardianConfidentialityRules.legalBasisToVerify: Age of independent access to contraception and sexual health services. Check the Constitution of Zimbabwe s.76 (health care) and s.81 (rights of children), the Children's Act [Chapter 5:06], the Marriages Act (2022), and the National Adolescent and Youth Sexual and Reproductive Health Strategy in force.
openQuestions: Contraception, STI treatment and termination of pregnancy may each carry a different threshold — should this be one rule or three?

How does the mandatory-reporting duty for a sexual offence against a minor interact with confidentiality from the guardian? This is the sharpest conflict in the whole pack and must be resolved before any threshold is set.
sourceRefs: TO BE SUPPLIED BY MoHCC / legal review

guardianConfidentialityRules.legalBasisToVerify: Check the Mental Health Act [Chapter 15:12] and its provisions on minors, consent and the role of a guardian.
openQuestions: Where a young person discloses suicidal intent, confidentiality from the guardian may be actively unsafe. Does the pack need a per-record safety override, distinct from the category rule?
sourceRefs: TO BE SUPPLIED BY MoHCC / legal review

guardianConfidentialityRules.legalBasisToVerify: Child protection duties under the Children's Act [Chapter 5:06] and MoHCC/Department of Social Development safeguarding procedure.
openQuestions: A safeguarding disclosure frequently concerns the guardian themselves, so confidentiality here is not age-derived at all — it is relational. This category probably needs a rule shape the other categories do not: confidential from a NAMED person regardless of age. Flagged rather than guessed.
sourceRefs: TO BE SUPPLIED BY MoHCC / legal review

guardianConfidentialityRules.legalBasisToVerify: Check MoHCC substance-use treatment policy and any provisions on minors' consent to treatment.
sourceRefs: TO BE SUPPLIED BY MoHCC / legal review

guardianConfidentialityRules.legalBasisToVerify: Check the Domestic Violence Act [Chapter 5:16] and the national GBV clinical management protocol, including mandatory-reporting duties.
openQuestions: As with safeguarding, the person the record must be confidential FROM may be the guardian. Relational, not age-derived.
sourceRefs: TO BE SUPPLIED BY MoHCC / legal review

testCases.name: an unratified pack grants no category
an unratified pack cannot be enforced
a ratified and effective pack exposes its categories
ratified but not effective is still inert — both flags must agree
an age rule with a null threshold is not usable even when the pack is ratified
